_about: What the server draws a Mermaid diagram with. `version`, `fontFamily` and the shared `limits` equal frontend/src/utils/mermaidRenderConfig.json (backend/tests/test_diagram_config.py fails when they differ), so a diagram reads the same in a report as on the screen; `converter/tests/test_diagram.py` checks `version` against the Mermaid library inside the installed renderer. `serverRenderMilliseconds` is the server's own wall-clock limit: its engine is an interpreter, much slower than a browser on a large diagram.
